evidence.text: This course provides students with knowledge and skills in systems analysis and design, including: techniques for system investigation and requirements elicitation, functional analysis, structural and behavioral systems analysis, class design, data design, and user interface design.
Explain the role of analysis and design in the software development life cycle;

Explain the process of elicitation, requirement gathering, and analysis of system functionality, structure, and behavior using UML diagrams: use case diagrams, class diagrams, sequence diagrams, state machine diagrams, and activity diagrams. Explain the process of class design, data design, and user interface design.

Apply the analysis and design process, use software design tools and the UML language to model a specific software system, and develop technical design documents and software solution designs that meet requirements. Apply teamwork skills to achieve learning objectives.

Develop a sense of responsibility and professional ethics in conducting system analysis and design activities. Demonstrate initiative in gathering and processing information, updating new knowledge and software development trends.
Apply information technology knowledge to determine system requirements, structure, and processing logic
Propose system design solutions using UML modeling language and software design tools
Overview of Software Systems Analysis and Design
System Functional Analysis Using Use Case Diagrams
System Business Analysis Using Activity Diagrams
System Structural Analysis Using Class Diagrams
